I'm protest voting against this knowing that it'll pass

I can't support something done in such a sloppy way:
- proposal was submitted with basic errors including pasting an extra (wrong) boilerplate into the proposal text at the top
- author refused to pull and fix, eventually caving to pressure
- author made significant content edits in the immediate resubmit without even updating the thread
Nonetheless, the author said they learned from this and won't make the same mistakes in the future, so this proposal might as well just pass

> Alarmed that Clause 1. Article a. defines “medical facility” as a structure dedicated to preserving life “after the immediate effects of injury or disease”, a very narrow qualifier that excludes facilities no less important to public health, such as those dedicated to research, nutrition, and preventative medicine, from the resolution’s protections,
This is brand new and a bad argument. Is warcrime legislation supposed to protect dietician offices? Ironically, if the target actually did protect every doctor's office and public health facility under the sun, it would be a far stronger repeal hook
